title: The Third Witness
author: Ada Ashgrove
blurb: Sebastian Brightwater, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
